database-missing-index-fk-1.description: IF foreign key column AND NOT index exists(fk column) — Column user_id in orders table has FK but no index

database-missing-index-hot-path-2.description: IF join column in slow query log AND NOT index exists(join column) — Join on product_id in order_items table appears frequently in slow queries

database-full-table-scan-3.description: IF table rows > 1 000 000 AND seq scan in explain plan — Large table user_sessions (2.1M rows) shows sequential scan in EXPLAIN

database-missing-index-where-4.description: IF where column used frequently AND NOT index exists(where column) — Column status in jobs table used in WHERE clauses but not indexed

database-missing-composite-index-5.description: IF composite where conditions AND NOT composite index exists — Queries frequently filter on (user_id, created_at) but no composite index

database-irreversible-migration-1.description: IF migration drops column AND NOT has rollback — Migration V2__drop_unused_column.sql drops column without backup strategy

database-irreversible-migration-2.description: IF migration renames table AND NOT has rollback — Migration renames users to legacy_users without data preservation plan

database-risky-migration-3.description: IF migration changes column type AND data loss possible AND NOT has rollback — Changing VARCHAR(255) to VARCHAR(50) may truncate existing data

database-not-null-violation-4.description: IF migration adds not null without default — Adding NOT NULL column without DEFAULT value will fail on existing rows

database-heavy-migration-5.description: IF migration performs heavy operation on large table — Adding index on large table during peak hours may cause downtime

database-n-plus-one-risk-1.description: IF orm loop detected AND relation not eager loaded — User.orders accessed in loop without include/join in UserService.java

database-n-plus-one-confirmed-2.description: IF query count in logs > 100 per request AND same table — Application logs show 150 SELECT queries to orders_per_user per request

database-lazy-loading-danger-3.description: IF orm lazy loading enabled AND high traffic endpoints — Lazy loading enabled on User.orders in API endpoint with 1000 RPM

database-missing-prefetch-4.description: IF missing select related or prefetch related — Django ORM access to related objects without select_related/prefetch_related

database-iteration-overload-5.description: IF orm iteration over large resultset — Code iterates over QuerySet without pagination or chunking

database-sequential-pagination-1.description: IF sequential count and findmany on paginated endpoint — prisma.article.count() awaited immediately before prisma.article.findMany() on the same list endpoint

database-overfetch-relation-1.description: IF full relation included to derive single flag — include: { favoritedBy: true } loads the entire many-to-many relation only to compute favoritedBy.some(f => f.id === id)

database-oversized-pool-1.description: IF pool size > cpu cores * 4 — Connection pool set to 100 on 4-core CPU

database-undersized-pool-2.description: IF pool size < 2 AND concurrent requests > 10 — Pool size of 1 with expected 50 concurrent users

database-connection-timeout-high-3.description: IF connection timeout > 30 seconds — Connection timeout set to 120 seconds masks pool exhaustion

database-idle-timeout-missing-4.description: IF idle timeout not configured — Connections may remain idle indefinitely consuming resources

database-max-lifetime-missing-5.description: IF max lifetime not configured — Connections may accumulate metadata over time

database-pg-stat-statements-disabled-1.description: IF pg stat statements not enabled — pg_stat_statements extension not enabled in shared_preload_libraries

database-work-mem-too-low-2.description: IF work mem too low — work_mem setting of 4MB may cause excessive disk sorting

database-maintenance-work-mem-too-low-3.description: IF maintenance work mem too low — maintenance_work_mem of 16MB slows VACUUM and index creation

database-effective-cache-misconfigured-4.description: IF effective cache poorly configured — effective_cache_value should reflect OS + DB cache availability

database-missing-bloat-monitoring-5.description: IF missing pg bloat monitoring — No monitoring for table/index bloat which degrades performance over time

database-unused-indexes-6.description: IF unused indexes detected — Index idx_old_column shows zero scans over monitoring period

database-index-bloat-7.description: IF index bloat significant — Index bloat > 30% indicates maintenance opportunity

database-missing-app-pool-8.description: IF missing connection pooling in application — Application creates new connections per request instead of pooling

database-statement-timeout-missing-9.description: IF statement timeout not configured — Long-running queries can block resources indefinitely

database-lock-timeout-missing-10.description: IF lock timeout not configured — Row locks can block transactions indefinitely
